result.stdout:
codemap - package repositories into AI-friendly output

Usage:
  codemap [options]
  codemap stdout [options]       Print packed content to stdout
  codemap clipboard [options]    Copy packed content to clipboard
  codemap config [options]       Save global options for future commands

Source:
  -r, --remote <url|owner/repo> Clone a remote Git repository
  -b, --remote-branch <branch>  Branch to clone

Selection:
  -i, --include <patterns>      Files, folders, or comma-separated globs
  -e, --exclude <patterns>      Files, folders, or comma-separated globs
  -m, --max-file-size <bytes>   Skip larger files

Output:
  -f, --format <xml|markdown|json|plain>
  -o, --output <path>           Output file (default: codemap-output.md)
  --stdout                      Print packed content to stdout
  --clipboard                   Copy packed content to clipboard
  --output-mode <file|stdout|clipboard>  Default output destination
  --copy-to-clipboard           Also copy file or stdout output to clipboard
  --no-copy-to-clipboard        Override config and disable automatic copying
  -a, --apply <patch-file>      Preview, approve, and apply a Git diff
  --no-summary                  Omit summary metadata
  --summary                     Include summary metadata
  --no-tree                     Omit directory structure
  --tree                        Include directory structure
  --split-output <bytes>        Split large output into numbered files
  -p, --patch                   Add patch-generation instructions in selected format
  -s, --skills <names|paths>     Load named or explicit Skills; comma-separated

Transformations and limits:
  --security-check              Exclude files with DevSkim findings
  --no-security-check           Disable security scanning
  --remove-comments             Remove common source comments
  --no-remove-comments          Preserve source comments
  --remove-empty-lines          Remove blank lines
  --no-remove-empty-lines       Preserve blank lines
  --line-numbers                Add line numbers
[truncated]
